# Repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for project context, architecture,
coding conventions, verification, and repository hygiene.

Use the [development guide](../docs/development/README.md) for setup and checks,
and the [architecture map](../docs/development/architecture.md) to locate code.
Follow [AI_POLICY.md](../AI_POLICY.md) when preparing a contribution. Keep shared
guidance in those files so assistant-specific instructions stay consistent.

Read the relevant subtree `AGENTS.md` for library code, tests, examples, or
documentation. Shared workflows in `.agents/skills/` and role descriptions in
`docs/development/agent-roles.md` are available as task guidance. Native hook and
subagent configurations for other clients do not automatically run in Copilot.
